title: Acquire full hospital-incinerator bottom-ash bioleaching study
body:
The bounded round77 discovery identified Anjum F, Shahid M, Bukhari SA, Potgieter JH, “Combined ultrasonic and bioleaching treatment of hospital waste incinerator bottom ash with simultaneous extraction of selected metals”, Environmental Technology 35(3):262–270 (2014; online 2013), DOI 10.1080/09593330.2013.824992, PMID 24600864. This is a deferred source acquisition task, not a defect in the accepted spent-tantalum-capacitor record.

Actual 2026-10-14 attempts:

- https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/pdf/10.1080/09593330.2013.824992 → HTTP 403.
- https://www.researchgate.net/publication/260603951_Combined_ultrasonic_and_bioleaching_treatment_of_hospital_waste_incinerator_bottom_ash_with_simultaneous_extraction_of_selected_metals → HTTP 403; the indexed author upload did not provide an acquired complete original.
- OpenAlex and Crossref APIs returned metadata; OpenAlex exposed DOI/PubMed locations but no accepted full text. Exact receipts are in the round77 resource dossier and `/private/tmp/cmm-round77-resources-research/acquisition-1.json`.

Use a new legitimate repository, author manuscript or licensed library route rather than repeat unchanged denied URLs. Do not infer microbial results from coal fly ash, municipal ash or chemical-only bottom-ash studies.

Acceptance criteria:

1. Acquire and hash the complete original and any supplements; verify content type and inspect all claim-bearing methods, tables and figures. Preserve publication versus online dates and reading/reuse terms.
2. Verify hospital-incinerator bottom-ash identity and pretreatment, fungal or filtrate provenance, ultrasound exposure, medium/pH/temperature/time/loading and controls/replication.
3. Separate ultrasound-only, biological-only and combined arms; retain metal denominators, analytical/detection limits, nulls and conflicting measurements. Do not equate liquor mobilization with isolated recovery.
4. Recheck corpus and all-state issues by normalized DOI/feed identity. Create a scoped owner only if primary evidence supports a useful distinct material, followed by canonical history, independent native review and gates. Otherwise document the remaining gap and keep this issue open.

The provided complete paginated initial all-state issue inventory was searched by DOI/hospital-ash/Anjum terms, with no matching source issue. Exact inventory digest and bounds are in the dossier; this is not a claim about future issue creation.

Source assessment: `research/sources/round77-resources/20261014T172009Z.md` on the current curation branch. This task remains open until the full-source acceptance criteria are met.
dedup_scope: All-state fully paginated issues excluding PRs; DOI, Anjum, hospital ash/incinerator title and body terms; zero matches before creation.
